# TGL — Touch Grass Later (Muse Agent Harness)

A spec-driven harness that turns a Muse coding agent into a disciplined build team: Plan Mode grills you one question at a time, writes a spec and a sliced plan, and waits for your sign-off before any code; Attack Mode then executes the plan slice by slice with reviews and red-teaming. Load its SKILL.md into your Muse agent and say "run TGL". Draft: Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
